copy.hero: Convert ordinary desktop, video, game, and media content into stereo 3D output for large displays, VR viewing, and 3D display experiments.
copy.intro: Cross-vendor hardware, multiple operating systems, and several output paths for real 2D-to-3D workflows.
copy.compatibility_copy: Desktop2Stereo is designed for cross-vendor GPU acceleration and mainstream desktop operating systems.
copy.features_title: Broad hardware support, tunable stereo parameters, multiple 3D outputs.
copy.features_copy: A layered real-time pipeline captures input, estimates depth, synthesizes stereo eyes, and presents the result to local display, OpenXR, stream, export, or API targets.
copy.feature_items.item_01.item_02: Monitor, window, image, video, and API frames enter one real-time stereoscopic synthesis pipeline.
copy.feature_items.item_02.item_02: Capture, depth, synthesis, hole fill, temporal, and pack stages stay on CUDA / ROCm / MPS / XPU where possible.
copy.feature_items.item_03.item_02: Run locally, use OpenXR Link with a headset, or send stereo output through MJPEG / RTMP / HLS.
copy.feature_items.item_04.item_02: Half-SBS, Full-SBS, Half-TAB, Full-TAB, Depth Map, Anaglyph, Interleaved, Mono, and Leia output.
copy.feature_items.item_05.item_02: Adjust parallax, depth strength, convergence, separation, edge, hole fill, temporal, render scale, and FPS.
copy.feature_items.item_06.item_02: Choose depth models and resolution, enable FP16 acceleration, stabilize video temporally, and reset scenes.
copy.feature_items.item_07.item_02: Use the GitHub source package or the lazy package with a complete Python runtime environment.
copy.parameter_items.item_01.item_02: local_display, network_stream, openxr, debug_export, headless_api, auto
copy.parameter_items.item_03.item_02: local_window, local_fullscreen, encoded_stream, openxr_swapchain, file_export, api_result
copy.parameter_items.item_04.item_02: Traditional / Fastest, Cinema, Game / Low Latency, Image / High Quality
copy.parameter_items.item_05.item_02: Parallax Budget, Depth Strength, Convergence, Dynamic Convergence, Depth Separation
copy.parameter_items.item_06.item_02: Edge Threshold, Edge Dilation, Mask Feather, Hole Fill Mode, Depth Antialias
copy.download_copy: Mainland China users should usually start with the lazy package. Other users can start from GitHub source and install Python requirements manually.
copy.source_copy: Download the repository source with requirements.txt, then create and install the Python runtime environment yourself.
copy.lazy_copy: The prepackaged archive includes a complete Python runtime environment to reduce setup friction.
copy.external_notice: GitHub, Quark Netdisk and Baidu Netdisk are external services. You will leave this website.
copy.guide_title: Use the official README as the operating manual.
copy.guide_copy: The README is the canonical source for hardware requirements, dependency installation, quick start, model selection, and troubleshooting.
copy.steps.item_01.item_02: Pick the GitHub source or China lazy package for your region and setup preference.
copy.steps.item_02.item_02: Create the Python environment and install requirements.txt as described in the README.
copy.steps.item_03.item_02: Follow the quick-run instructions and choose the proper mode for desktop, video, or game content.
copy.steps.item_04.item_02: Adjust stereo strength, depth model, display mode, and runtime settings for your hardware.
copy.platforms_copy: The configured GitHub repository is the source for releases, source files, and project history.
copy.platform_items.item_01.item_02: Repository, README, source files, requirements, and issue history.
copy.platform_items.item_02.item_02: Open the current Desktop2Stereo release on GitHub.
copy.platform_items.item_03.item_02: Quark and Baidu lazy packages with a complete runtime.
copy.platform_items.item_04.item_02: GitHub source plus Python dependency setup.
copy.community_title: Join the official QQ discussion group.
copy.community_copy: For usage questions, troubleshooting, and Chinese community discussion, scan the QR code to join the D2S official QQ group.
copy.support_copy: Turning 2D video into real-time 3D in VR is expensive to maintain. Sponsorship helps fund monthly model tokens, distribution storage, and continued image-quality work.
copy.support_note: If sponsorship is not convenient, a free GitHub Star or sharing the project in a VR group helps just as much.
copy.project_items.item_01: Official releases and source are published through GitHub.
copy.project_items.item_02: Resources include English and Chinese documentation.
copy.project_items.item_03: Account licensing, device sessions and private support are managed on this website.
